detail: 2026-08-11 fresh Gate evidence: ops/tests/test_ops_ci_coverage.sh reports four tracked test files unreachable from every DEFAULT_TESTS run_one path: ops/tests/test_task_registry.py, ops/tests/test_worktree_campaign_reservation.py, ops/tests/test_worktree_handback_outcomes.py, and ops/tests/test_worktree_parent_integration.py. The same run also reports an ios-ops baseline failure; that is a separate prerequisite ticket for the runner import defect and must not be absorbed here. Canonical lookup found no open ticket that owns these four registration paths, and IMP-20260806-79f81c is limited to optional-only reachability.
